content: Fig. FIGREF40 and FIGREF40 represent histograms of the vertical forget gate values from the second and the third layer. From the figures we can validate that the trained model does not fall into the degenerate case where vertical forget gates are ignored. Also the figures show that the values are right-skewed, which we conjecture to be a result of focusing more on a strong interaction between adjacent layers.
